title: Effects of COVID-19 vaccination type and vaccination-infection interval on viral clearance dynamics in Omicron BA.5 patients at Guangzhou Fangcang shelter hospitals: A propensity score matched multicenter retrospective cohort study
abstract: ABSTRACT The Omicron BA.5 subvariant exhibited pronounced immune evasion and was associated with widespread breakthrough infections. Unlike settings where mRNA vaccines predominated, China mainly used inactivated vaccines, with the adenovirus type 5-vectored vaccine Ad5-nCoV also administered at scale. Real-world evidence on post-infection viral clearance associated with these platforms remains limited. This multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled 16,533 mild or asymptomatic Omicron BA.5 cases from two Fangcang shelter hospitals in Guangzhou, China, from Novernber 5 to December 8, 2022. The primary objective was to compare viral-clearance time between unvaccinated and vaccinated participants. The secondary objective was to compare inactivated-vaccine recipients, or and Ad5-nCoV recipients, containing regimens in a propensity score-matched cohort; the last-dose-to-infection interval analysis was exploratory. Propensity score matching was performed using age, sex, marital status, occupation, and province as covariates to improve between-group comparability. All patients underwent standardized daily RT-PCR testing containing both N and ORF1ab genes, with Ct values > 35 defined as negative. The outcome was time to viral clearance, defined as two consecutive negative nasopharyngeal swabs ≥ 24 hours apart. In the overall cohort, vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration (9.05 vs... 10.42d; P < .001) compared with unvaccinated patients. The matched cohort included 228 unvaccinated, 228 inactivated vaccine recipients, and 114 Ad5-nCoV recipients. Median time to viral clearance differed across groups with 9.42, 8.56, and 8.48d, respectively. Prior vaccination was associated with shorter viral clearance but with no significant difference observed between inactivated vaccine and Ad5-nCoV recipients among the matched regimens.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the effects of vaccination type and the interval between vaccination and infection on viral clearance dynamics in patients infected with the Omicron BA.5 subvariant of SARS-CoV-2. Conducted in Guangzhou Fangcang shelter hospitals from November 5 to December 8, 2022, the multicenter retrospective cohort study enrolled 16,533 mild or asymptomatic cases. Propensity score matching was used to compare unvaccinated, inactivated vaccine recipients, and Ad5-nCoV recipients. Results showed that vaccinated patients had significantly shorter shedding duration compared to unvaccinated patients, but no significant difference was observed between inactivated vaccine and Ad5-nCoV recipients. The findings suggest that prior vaccination may influence viral clearance time, which could inform vaccine strategies in regions where these vaccines are predominantly used. However, the study's retrospective design and potential confounding factors limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨不同疫苗接种类型以及疫苗接种与感染之间的时间间隔对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2奥密克戎BA.5亚变种感染患者病毒清除动力学的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本项多中心回顾性队列研究研究纳入了2022年11月5日至12月8日期间在广州两家方舱医院中确诊的16,533例轻症或无症状的Omicron BA.5病例。研究比较了未接种疫苗和接种疫苗患者的病毒清除时间,次要目的是比较灭活疫苗接种者和Ad5-nCoV接种者的病毒清除时间。
elements_zh.methods: 采用倾向评分匹配方法确保组间可比性,协变量包括年龄、性别、婚姻状况、职业和省份。所有患者均接受标准化的每日RT-PCR检测,检测目标为N和ORF1ab基因,Ct值>35定义为阴性。病毒清除定义为两次连续的鼻咽拭子检测结果为阴性,且间隔至少24小时。
elements_zh.main_results: 在总体队列研究中,接种疫苗的患者病毒清除时间显著短于未接种疫苗的患者(9.05 vs 10.42天;P < .001)。匹配后的队列研究包括228例未接种疫苗者、228例灭活疫苗接种者和114例Ad5-nCoV接种者。各组的病毒清除中位时间分别为9.42天、8.56天和8.48天。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,先前的疫苗接种与较短的病毒清除时间相关,但在匹配的接种方案中,灭活疫苗和Ad5-nCoV接种者之间未观察到显著差异。本研究为了解Omicron BA.5患者中疫苗接种类型对病毒清除动力学的影响提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为Omicron BA.5感染背景下疫苗的选择和接种时间制定公共卫生策略提供参考,特别是在主要使用灭活疫苗的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究为回顾性设计,可能存在混杂因素,尽管使用了倾向评分匹配以提高可比性,因此证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨不同疫苗接种类型以及疫苗接种与感染之间的时间间隔对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2奥密克戎BA.5亚变种感染患者病毒清除动力学的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本项多中心回顾性队列研究研究纳入了2022年11月5日至12月8日期间在广州两家方舱医院中确诊的16,533例轻症或无症状的Omicron BA.5病例。研究比较了未接种疫苗和接种疫苗患者的病毒清除时间,次要目的是比较灭活疫苗接种者和Ad5-nCoV接种者的病毒清除时间。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用倾向评分匹配方法确保组间可比性,协变量包括年龄、性别、婚姻状况、职业和省份。所有患者均接受标准化的每日RT-PCR检测,检测目标为N和ORF1ab基因,Ct值>35定义为阴性。病毒清除定义为两次连续的鼻咽拭子检测结果为阴性,且间隔至少24小时。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,先前的疫苗接种与较短的病毒清除时间相关,但在匹配的接种方案中,灭活疫苗和Ad5-nCoV接种者之间未观察到显著差异。本研究为了解Omicron BA.5患者中疫苗接种类型对病毒清除动力学的影响提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为Omicron BA.5感染背景下疫苗的选择和接种时间制定公共卫生策略提供参考,特别是在主要使用灭活疫苗的地区。

title: Reinfection with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS CoV-2) among healthcare workers in India.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Healthcare workers (HCWs) remain at heightened risk of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection due to sustained occupational exposure. The emergence of the Omicron variant, characterized by increased transmissibility and immune escape, had led to a rise in reinfections despite prior infection and vaccination. However, evidence on reinfection dynamics among HCWs in India remains limited. METHODS: A multicentric prospective cohort study was conducted across 11 tertiary care hospitals in India between December 2021 and March 2023. HCWs with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection were enrolled retrospectively (within 4 weeks prior) and prospectively (8-month follow-up. Reinfection was defined using epidemiological criteria and confirmed by whole-genome sequencing wherever paired samples were available. Socio-demographic, clinical, exposure, immunological, and laboratory data were collected using standardized case report forms. title_zh: 印度医护人员中严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2)的再感染情况
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Healthcare workers (HCWs) remain at heightened risk of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection due to sustained occupational exposure. The emergence of the Omicron variant, characterized by increased transmissibility and immune escape, had led to a rise in reinfections despite prior infection and vaccination. However, evidence on reinfection dynamics among HCWs in India remains limited. METHODS: A multicentric prospective cohort study was conducted across 11 tertiary care hospitals in India between December 2021 and March 2023. HCWs with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection were enrolled retrospectively (within 4 weeks prior) and prospectively (8-month follow-up. Reinfection was defined using epidemiological criteria and confirmed by whole-genome sequencing wherever paired samples were available. Socio-demographic, clinical, exposure, immunological, and laboratory data were collected using standardized case report forms. Reinfection incidence was estimated, and bivariate analysis was performed to identify factors associated with reinfection. RESULTS: Of 1,598 HCWs screened, 1,334 (83.4%) were enrolled and 1,331 (83.3%) completed follow-ups. Thirteen participants developed confirmed SARS-CoV-2 reinfection, yielding a cumulative incidence of 9.7 per 1,000 individuals and an incidence density of 2.97 per 100,000 person-days (95% CI: 1.73-5.11). The median interval between infection episodes was 193 days (IQR: 183-211). All reinfection cases were symptomatic but mild, with no hospitalizations or requirement for oxygen therapy. Whole-genome sequencing identified predominant circulation of Delta and Omicron lineages, with complete paired genome sequences confirming reinfection with genetically distinct. Although reinfection was more frequent among HCWs working in COVID-19 care areas (OR = 1.93; 95% CI: 0.63-5.95) and those aged ≥60 years (OR = 2.28; 95% CI: 0.29-18.15), these associations were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: SARS-CoV-2 reinfection occurred among HCWs during the Omicron-dominant period, with moderate incidence and predominantly mild clinical outcomes. Occupational exposure and recent contact history may contribute to reinfection risk. These findings underscore the importance of sustained infection prevention strategies and continued vaccination efforts to mitigate disease severity in high-risk populations.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于持续的职业暴露,医护人员(HCWs)仍面临严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2)感染的高风险。然而,关于印度医护人员中再感染动态的证据仍然有限。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在印度11家三级医疗机构中,于2021年12月至2023年3月期间开展了一项多中心前瞻性研究。所有实验室确诊严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2感染的医护人员被纳入研究,包括回顾性纳入(在4周内)和前瞻性纳入(8个月随访)。
analysis_zh.methods: 再感染通过流行病学标准定义,并在有配对样本的情况下通过全基因组测序确认。使用标准化表格收集了社会人口学、临床、暴露、免疫学和实验室数据。估计了再感染的发病率,并进行了双变量分析以确定与再感染相关的因素。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 具有更高传播性和免疫逃逸特性的奥密克戎变种的出现,导致再感染数量增加,即使之前感染过严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2并接种了疫苗。在奥密克戎主导的时期,医护人员中发生了严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2再感染,再感染的发病率中等,且临床结果主要为轻微。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了持续实施感染预防策略和继续疫苗接种工作的重要性,以减轻高风险人群的疾病严重程度。

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in healthcare workers in Trieste and Gorizia, Northeast Italy, from 1 December 2021 to 31 May 2022. It focused on analyzing SARS-CoV-2 infections and vaccine effectiveness during the Omicron period.
analysis.methods: The study utilized data from healthcare workers, including testing and vaccination records, to assess infection rates and vaccine effectiveness. It involved tracking cases and comparing outcomes between vaccinated and unvaccinated individuals.
analysis.main_results: The study reported that SARS-CoV-2 infections occurred in healthcare workers during the Omicron period, with some cases indicating re-infections. Vaccine effectiveness was noted but not quantified in the supplied evidence.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the importance of monitoring vaccine effectiveness against Omicron in healthcare workers, though the results were not detailed in the supplied text.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for monitoring and managing SARS-CoV-2 infections and vaccine effectiveness in healthcare workers during future Omicron waves.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the retraction notice, which suggests the findings may not be reliable. The evidence strength is low due to the retraction.

analysis.summary_en: This retracted study aimed to assess primary SARS-CoV-2 infections, re-infections, and vaccine effectiveness among healthcare workers in Trieste and Gorizia, Northeast Italy, during the Omicron transmission period from December 2021 to May 2022. The study design involved analyzing testing and vaccination records to evaluate infection rates and vaccine effectiveness. The main results indicated that infections occurred, with some cases of re-infection, but vaccine effectiveness was not quantified. The authors interpreted these findings as relevant for understanding the impact of Omicron on healthcare workers, though the study's reliability is questionable due to the retraction. The results may have implications for public health strategies, but the evidence strength is low due to the retraction. The study's limitations include the retraction itself, which undermines the confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 2021 年 12 月 1 日至 2022 年 5 月 31 日期间,意大利东北部 Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区医疗工作者在奥密克戎时期首次 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染、再感染及 疫苗 有效性情况。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在意大利东北部 Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区的医疗工作者中进行,时间为 2021 年 12 月 1 日至 2022 年 5 月 31 日。研究重点分析了奥密克戎时期 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染及 疫苗 有效性。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用医疗工作者的检测数据和 疫苗接种 记录,评估感染率和 疫苗 有效性。研究包括追踪病例,并比较接种疫苗与未接种疫苗个体的结局。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究报告指出,在奥密克戎时期,Trieste 和 Gorizia 地区的医疗工作者中发生了 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染,部分病例显示为再感染。疫苗 有效性被提及,但未在提供的证据中量化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调在奥密克戎时期监测 疫苗 有效性对医疗工作者的重要性,尽管提供的文本中未详细说明结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来奥密克戎波浪中监测和管理 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染及 疫苗 有效性提供公共卫生成果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于撤回通知,本研究存在局限性,表明研究结果可能不可靠。由于撤回,证据强度较低。

title: [Dynamics of behavioral factors and attitudes toward vaccination in moscow during the COVID-19 pandemic: from the acute phase to adaptation].
abstract: BACKGROUND: The transition of the COVID-19 pandemic from the acute phase to adaptation was accompanied by changes in preventive behavior, institutional trust, emotional state and attitudes toward vaccination. OBJECTIVE: To analyze the dynamics of awareness, preventive behavior, trust, emotional state and attitudes toward vaccination among Moscow residents in 2021 compared with 2020. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The survey tool was developed by the WHO Regional Office for Europe with support from the University of Erfurt and adapted to the Moscow context. CATI was conducted using a stratified dual-frame sample. The article analyzes the 4th and 5th survey waves: February 2021 (n = 1038) and July-August 2021 (n = 998). RESULTS: By the 5th wave, adherence to most preventive measures decreased, especially social distancing, limiting contacts and using hand sanitizers. The proportion not wearing gloves increased sharply after the requirement was lifted. The mean self-assessment of emotional state decreased to 3.47 points; institutional assessments declined and vaccination attitudes became more polarized. CONCLUSIONS: Public health strategies should combine consistent scientific communication, targeted work with vaccine-hesitant groups and horizontal trust.

title: COVID-19 vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions in selected European settings: a systematic review
abstract: BACKGROUND: COVID-19 pandemic responses in European countries relied on both vaccination campaigns and non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs). While vaccination reduced severe disease, NPIs remained necessary to limit transmission, particularly during periods of variant emergence. However, the effectiveness of these strategies depended on social trust, communication clarity, and behavioural adaptation. OBJECTIVE: To synthesize empirical evidence on shared determinants of vaccination and NPI-related behaviours, behavioural relationships between these strategies, and evidence concerning their joint epidemiological effects. METHODS: PubMed and Scopus were searched on 11 February 2025 using free-text terms for COVID-19, vaccination, and social or non-pharmaceutical measures. Eligible studies were peer-reviewed, empirical (quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-methods), conducted by authors affiliated with selected European institutions, and examined relationships between vaccination and NPIs. Studies based solely on modelling or secondary data were excluded. Data were synthesized narratively due to heterogeneity of study designs and outcomes. RESULTS: Twelve studies met inclusion criteria. Trust in scientific and governmental authorities consistently predicted adherence to NPIs and willingness to vaccinate. Sweden's reliance on voluntary measures was effective where institutional trust was high. In contrast, inconsistent communication in the United Kingdom contributed to reduced adherence and public frustration. Vaccinated individuals tended to increase social contacts, an association compatible with behavioural adaptation. A conjoint experiment examined stated vaccination preferences in relation to NPI attributes. Younger populations experienced notable psychological strain during prolonged restrictions. CONCLUSIONS: The synthesis primarily informs social and behavioural relationships involving vaccination and NPIs. Shared determinants and behavioural associations should not be interpreted as evidence of synergistic effects on infection, hospitalisation, or mortality. Future pandemic preparedness should prioritize trust-building, consistent messaging, and targeted psychosocial support for vulnerable groups.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 疫苗接种 与非药物干预措施(NPIs)在欧洲各国大流行应对中的相互作用,特别是在变异株出现期间。背景指出,这些策略对于控制 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 的传播至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本系统综述综合了十二项在选定欧洲国家进行的实证研究,重点探讨了 疫苗接种 与 NPIs 之间的行为关系,以及它们联合的流行病学效应。研究时间跨度为 2020 年至 2023 年。
elements_zh.methods: 综述通过于 2025 年 2 月 11 日在 PubMed 和 Scopus 上使用与 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、疫苗接种 以及社会或非药物措施相关的自由文本术语进行检索。仅基于建模或次级数据的研究被排除。
elements_zh.main_results: 十二项研究符合纳入标准。对科学和政府机构的信任始终预测了对 NPIs 的依从性以及接种疫苗的意愿。瑞典依赖自愿措施在机构信任度高的情况下是有效的,而英国信息传达不一致导致依从性下降和公众不满。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,对机构的信任和信息传达的一致性是影响 疫苗接种 和 NPIs 有效性的重要因素。这一发现突显了社会决定因素在大流行应对策略中的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,未来的大流行准备应优先考虑建立信任、保持信息一致性和为弱势群体提供有针对性的心理社会支持,特别是在维持公共卫生措施依从性方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究设计和结果的异质性,证据采用叙述性方式进行综合,这限制了统计上稳健结论的得出。研究结果的可信度中等。

title: Genomic diversity of respiratory pathogens in clinical versus community surveillance: a comparative analysis of SARS-CoV-2, RSV, and influenza viruses in Washington State
abstract: Background: Genomic surveillance of respiratory viruses typically relies on sequences from individuals seeking health care, and whether these sequences represent the viruses circulating in the community is not well-characterized. We aimed to compare the diversity, proportion, and dynamics of influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2 between clinical and community samples. Methods In this retrospective comparative genomic analysis, we used whole-genome sequences from community-based surveillance studies in the Seattle area, and clinical sequences from the Washington State Department of Health. We compared clade proportions and dynamics, sequence-cluster diversity, non-synonymous mutations, and Ct values between clinical and community samples. Findings We analyzed 538 RSV sequences collected between 2019 and 2021 (278 community, 260 clinical), 1506 influenza sequences (260 community, 1246 clinical) between 2019 and 2020, and 8660 SARS-CoV-2 sequences (5923 community, 2737 clinical) from 2020 to 2022. Clade proportions did not differ between clinical and community samples for RSV or influenza, but differed for SARS-CoV-2: clades 21J (Delta) and 21K (Omicron BA.1) were more frequent in community samples and clade 22B (Omicron BA.5) in clinical samples. SARS-CoV-2 clinical sequence clusters were more diverse than community clusters, whereas RSV and influenza showed no significant difference. Several spike mutations associated with monoclonal antibody resistance were more prevalent in community samples for SARS-CoV-2. Ct values were lower in clinical samples for multiple SARS-CoV-2, RSV, and influenza clades. Interpretation Seasonal respiratory viruses had similar dynamics and diversity in clinical and community samples, whereas pandemic SARS-CoV-2 differed between settings. Genomic surveillance programs should combine clinical and community sampling, particularly during pandemics in order to better capture viral diversity.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the genomic diversity of SARS-CoV-2, RSV, and influenza viruses between clinical and community samples in Washington State. It highlights that while RSV and influenza showed similar dynamics in both settings, SARS-CoV-2 exhibited differences in clade proportions and sequence diversity. The findings suggest that combining clinical and community sampling is crucial for comprehensive genomic surveillance, especially during pandemics. The study provides insights into the representation of viral diversity in different sampling contexts, which has implications for public health strategies. However, the evidence does not explicitly report limitations or the strength of the findings.

title_zh: 临床与社区样本中呼吸道病原体的基因组多样性:华盛顿州流感、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)和严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的比较分析
source_body_en: Background: Genomic surveillance of respiratory viruses typically relies on sequences from individuals seeking health care, and whether these sequences represent the viruses circulating in the community is not well-characterized. We aimed to compare the diversity, proportion, and dynamics of influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and SARS-CoV-2 between clinical and community samples. Methods In this retrospective comparative genomic analysis, we used whole-genome sequences from community-based surveillance studies in the Seattle area, and clinical sequences from the Washington State Department of Health. We compared clade proportions and dynamics, sequence-cluster diversity, non-synonymous mutations, and Ct values between clinical and community samples. Findings We analyzed 538 RSV sequences collected between 2019 and 2021 (278 community, 260 clinical), 1506 influenza sequences (260 community, 1246 clinical) between 2019 and 2020, and 8660 SARS-CoV-2 sequences (5923 community, 2737 clinical) from 2020 to 2022. Clade proportions did not differ between clinical and community samples for RSV or influenza, but differed for SARS-CoV-2: clades 21J (Delta) and 21K (Omicron BA.1) were more frequent in community samples and clade 22B (Omicron BA.5) in clinical samples. SARS-CoV-2 clinical sequence clusters were more diverse than community clusters, whereas RSV and influenza showed no significant difference. Several spike mutations associated with monoclonal antibody resistance were more prevalent in community samples for SARS-CoV-2. Ct values were lower in clinical samples for multiple SARS-CoV-2, RSV, and influenza clades. Interpretation Seasonal respiratory viruses had similar dynamics and diversity in clinical and community samples, whereas pandemic SARS-CoV-2 differed between settings. Genomic surveillance programs should combine clinical and community sampling, particularly during pandemics in order to better capture viral diversity.
abstract_zh: 背景:呼吸道病毒的基因组监测通常依赖于寻求医疗帮助的个体的序列,这些序列是否代表社区中流行的病毒尚不明确。我们旨在比较流感、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)和严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2在临床样本和社区样本中的多样性、比例和动态变化。方法:在本回顾性比较基因组分析中,我们使用了来自西雅图地区基于社区的监测研究的全基因组序列,以及来自华盛顿州卫生部的临床序列。我们比较了临床样本和社区样本之间的分支比例和动态变化、序列簇多样性、非同义突变以及Ct值。结果:我们分析了2019年至2021年间收集的538个RSV序列(278个社区样本,260个临床样本)、2019年至2020年间收集的1506个流感序列(260个社区样本,1246个临床样本),以及2020年至2022年间收集的8660个严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2序列(5923个社区样本,2737个临床样本)。对于RSV和流感,临床样本与社区样本的分支比例没有显著差异,但严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的分支比例存在差异:分支21J(Delta)和21K(Omicron BA.1)在社区样本中更为常见,而分支22B(Omicron BA.5)在临床样本中更为常见。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2的临床序列簇比社区序列簇更具多样性,而RSV和流感则没有显著差异。对于严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2,与单克隆抗体抗性相关的多个刺突蛋白突变在社区样本中更为普遍。多个严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、RSV和流感分支的临床样本Ct值均低于社区样本。解释:季节性呼吸道病毒在临床样本和社区样本中的动态变化和多样性相似,而大流行期间的严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2则在不同环境中存在差异。基因组监测项目应结合临床和社区样本采集,特别是在大流行期间,以更好地捕捉病毒的多样性。

title: Outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic: decline of functional independence and frailty
abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza remains a heavy burden to the elderly and the situation has been affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. The objective of this study was to clarify outcomes of elderly hospitalized patients with influenza after the COVID-19 pandemic. METHODS: The clinical data of patients 65 years of age or older who were severely ill with influenza and required hospitalization in one center were gathered between September 2023 and March 2026 (3 influenza seasons after the COVID-19 pandemic). The outcomes, functional independence, and frailty of them were analyzed. RESULTS: A total of 210 elderly patients were enrolled. The median age was 79 and 32 cases were judged as having mild or more frailty by the clinical frailty scale (CFS) before admission. Pneumonia was the most common disease indicated as cause for hospitalization, followed by a poor general condition and heart failure. The median duration of hospitalization was 13 days and in-hospital deaths were recorded for 17 patients (8.1%). Sixty cases changed hospital due to further treatment or deterioration of activity of daily living, and the functional independence measure (FIM) of 37 cases (17.6%) remained under a score of 70 even after rehabilitation. The CFSs worsened in 19 cases (9.0%) at the time of discharge. CONCLUSIONS: Influenza infection remains a heavy burden among the elderly after the COVID-19 pandemic. The elderly tend to lose functional independence and fail to frailty even after recovery from acute illness. Preventive measures for influenza to avoid admission, including vaccination, will be essential. (Influenza Internet Survey, UMIN000015989).

abstract_zh: 背景:流感仍然是老年人群的沉重负担,且这一情况受到了新型冠状病毒感染大流行的影响。本研究的目的是明确新型冠状病毒感染大流行后住院老年流感患者的预后。方法:收集了2023年9月至2026年3月期间(新型冠状病毒感染大流行后3个流感季节)某中心65岁及以上严重流感患者需要住院的临床数据。分析了这些患者的预后、功能独立性和虚弱情况。结果:共纳入210名老年患者。中位年龄为79岁,入院前根据临床虚弱量表(CFS)判断有32例为轻度或更严重的虚弱。肺炎是住院最常见的原因,其次是总体状况差和心力衰竭。中位住院时间为13天,记录了17例住院期间死亡(占8.1%)。60例因进一步治疗或日常生活活动能力恶化而转院,且在康复后,37例(17.6%)的功能独立性量表(FIM)得分仍低于70。19例(9.0%)在出院时CFS有所恶化。结论:流感感染在新型冠状病毒感染大流行后仍然是老年人群的沉重负担。即使从急性疾病中恢复,老年人仍倾向于失去功能独立性并出现虚弱。预防流感以避免住院的措施,包括疫苗接种,将是至关重要的。(流感互联网调查,UMIN000015989)

title: Insights from SARS-CoV-2 nanopore genomic surveillance in Edo State, Nigeria
abstract: Abstract In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, local SARS-CoV-2 nanopore sequencing capacity was established at Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (ISTH), a Lassa fever reference centre based in Edo State, Nigeria. This was enabled through training of local staff in Nigeria and Guinea in both laboratory and bioinformatic SARS-CoV-2 sequencing protocols. Between March 2020 and December 2023, the laboratory at ISTH conducted 29,643 diagnostic tests for SARS-CoV-2, of which 4,575 (15.4%) were positive. Between April and December 2022, 410 SARS-CoV-2 positive samples were selected and retrospectively sequenced in 19 runs. From these, 213 near-complete (> 93%) viral genomes were generated and submitted to GISAID. Phylogenetic and phylogeographic analyses supported that Nigeria served simultaneously as a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, driving global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe. Here we show that a pre-existing long-term laboratory capacity development program for Lassa virus, a high-risk pathogen, facilitated the successful integration of novel workflows for a new emerging pathogen.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the role of Nigeria in the global spread of SARS-CoV-2 lineages through genomic surveillance, addressing the need for improved understanding of viral transmission dynamics in the region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective genomic surveillance study was conducted at Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (ISTH) in Edo State, Nigeria, using 410 SARS-CoV-2 positive samples collected between April and December 2022.
analysis.methods: The study involved training local staff in Nigeria and Guinea on laboratory and bioinformatic SARS-CoV-2 sequencing protocols, and sequencing 410 positive samples to generate 213 near-complete viral genomes.
analysis.main_results: Phylogenetic and phylogeographic analyses revealed that Nigeria acted as both a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, contributing to the global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate the utility of existing laboratory infrastructure for emerging pathogens, highlighting the importance of long-term capacity development for rapid response to outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform surveillance strategies and highlight the interconnectedness of viral spread across regions, supporting targeted public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential biases in sample selection, but the evidence is strong due to the comprehensive genomic data and clear phylogenetic analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents insights from SARS-CoV-2 nanopore genomic surveillance in Edo State, Nigeria, conducted between April and December 2022. It highlights the dual role of Nigeria as both a source and recipient of SARS-CoV-2 lineages, contributing to the global spread of the AY.36 Delta variant and receiving Omicron sublineages (BA.1.1 and BQ.1) from North America and Europe. The research underscores the importance of leveraging existing laboratory infrastructure for rapid response to emerging pathogens, demonstrating the value of long-term capacity development programs. The study's findings have significant implications for understanding viral transmission dynamics and improving public health surveillance strategies. However, the retrospective nature of the study and potential biases in sample selection may limit the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on genomic data and the absence of direct causal links.

elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育和系统地理分析表明,尼日利亚同时作为严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2谱系的来源和接收者,推动了AY.36 Delta变异株的全球传播,并从北美和欧洲接收了Omicron亚谱系(BA.1.1和BQ.1)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现展示了现有实验室基础设施在应对新兴病原体中的实用性,强调了长期能力建设对于快速响应暴发的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为监测策略提供了信息,并突显了病毒传播在不同地区的相互关联性,支持有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受到回顾性设计和样本选择潜在偏倚的限制,但由于全面的基因组数据和清晰的系统发育分析,其证据是强有力的。

title: Electrochemiluminescence as a Transformative Diagnostic Tool for SARS-CoV-2 Variant Detection: Implications for Future Pandemic Preparedness
abstract: Abstract Over the past two decades, the three major betacoronavirus outbreaks, SARS-CoV (2002), MERS-CoV (2012), and SARS-CoV-2 (2019), have resulted in millions of infections and deaths globally. SARS-CoV-2 has displayed rapid mutations, enhancing its transmissibility, immune evasion, and resistance to existing vaccines and diagnostics. For these reasons, it has been named the most notorious viral outbreak in modern history. Due to the ever-mutating Spike (S) protein, key interactions with bioreceptors have been disrupted, making conventional detection methods more challenging. To minimize viral spread and improve diagnostic accuracy, innovative biosensing technologies are critical. As such, electrochemiluminescence (ECL) offers a powerful biosensing platform for SARS-CoV-2 variant detection by combining the high sensitivity of optical detection with electrochemistry. Its advantages include culture-independent detection, low background noise, a broad dynamic range, and the ability to detect low viral concentrations. Recent advances in multiple disciplines, such as novel luminophore development, nanotechnology, lab-on-a-chip miniaturization, and AI-driven machine learning, have further enhanced its diagnostic powers. Furthermore, smartphone-integrated ECL platforms enable rapid, point-of-care testing, improving disease surveillance and outbreak response. By uniting AI with ECL biosensing, the diagnostic system can refine variant classification and predict emerging mutations, making ECL a promising candidate for the next generation of pandemic diagnostics. Despite the many advantages, there is limited research that has explored ECL for SARS-CoV-2 variant detection, which is addressed in this review. This review highlights ECL’s potential to become a gold-standard technique for detecting rapidly evolving pathogens, offering a robust and accessible solution for future infectious disease monitoring.

Due to the ever-mutating Spike (S) protein, key interactions with bioreceptors have been disrupted, making conventional detection methods more challenging. To minimize viral spread and improve diagnostic accuracy, innovative biosensing technologies are critical. As such, electrochemiluminescence (ECL) offers a powerful biosensing platform for SARS-CoV-2 variant detection by combining the high sensitivity of optical detection with electrochemistry. Its advantages include culture-independent detection, low background noise, a broad dynamic range, and the ability to detect low viral concentrations. Recent advances in multiple disciplines, such as novel luminophore development, nanotechnology, lab-on-a-chip miniaturization, and AI-driven machine learning, have further enhanced its diagnostic powers. Furthermore, smartphone-integrated ECL platforms enable rapid, point-of-care testing, improving disease surveillance and outbreak response. By uniting AI with ECL biosensing, the diagnostic system can refine variant classification and predict emerging mutations, making ECL a promising candidate for the next generation of pandemic diagnostics. Despite the many advantages, there is limited research that has explored ECL for SARS-CoV-2 variant detection, which is addressed in this review. This review highlights ECL’s potential to become a gold-standard technique for detecting rapidly evolving pathogens, offering a robust and accessible solution for future infectious disease monitoring.

abstract_zh: 摘要 在过去的二十年中,三种主要的β冠状病毒暴发、SARS-CoV(2002年)和MERS-CoV(2012年),以及严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2(2019年)在全球范围内引发了数百万例感染和死亡。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2表现出快速的突变,增强了其传播能力、免疫逃逸能力和对现有疫苗及诊断方法的抗性。因此,它被命名为现代历史上最臭名昭著的病毒暴发。由于刺突蛋白(S蛋白)不断发生突变,关键的与生物受体的相互作用被破坏,使得传统检测方法更加困难。为了减少病毒传播并提高诊断准确性,创新的生物传感技术至关重要。因此,电化学发光(ECL)通过结合光学检测的高灵敏度与电化学特性,为严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变种的检测提供了一种强大的生物传感平台。其优势包括无需培养即可检测、背景噪声低、动态范围广以及能够检测低病毒浓度。近年来,多个学科的最新进展,如新型发光体的开发、纳米技术、芯片实验室微型化以及人工智能驱动的机器学习,进一步增强了其诊断能力。此外,集成智能手机的ECL平台实现了快速、即时的检测,提高了疾病监测和暴发的应对能力。通过将人工智能与ECL生物传感技术结合,诊断系统可以优化变种分类并预测新兴的突变,使ECL成为下一代大流行病诊断的有前景候选技术。尽管ECL具有诸多优势,但目前针对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变种检测的研究仍较为有限,本文综述旨在解决这一问题。本文综述强调了ECL在检测快速进化的病原体方面的潜力,提供了一种强大且易于获取的解决方案,用于未来传染病的监测。

title: Evolving concerns: A longitudinal content analysis of free-text reports from the UK COVID-19 Public Experiences (COPE) study cohort
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Concerns are psychological appraisals of risk that can influence how people respond to threats, including those posed by infectious diseases. The aim of this study was to characterise the evolution of concerns reported by a community cohort during the first two years of the COVID-19 pandemic. DESIGN: Content analysis of qualitative descriptions of concerns in a prospective longitudinal online survey (COVID-19 UK Public Experiences (COPE) Study). METHOD: At baseline (March/April 2020), when the UK entered its first national lockdown, 11,113 adults completed the COPE survey. Follow-up surveys were conducted at 3, 12, 18 and 24 months. Participants were recruited via the HealthWise Wales research registry and social media. Baseline surveys collected demographic and health data. All waves included an open-ended question about COVID-19 concerns. Content analysis was used to identify the frequency of concerns coded to each category and number of individuals reporting concern(s) within each category at each survey wave, as participants could report multiple concerns. RESULTS: Across five survey waves, a total of 22,971 open-text responses were received. From these, 41,569 concerns were identified and coded into six main categories of concerns: personal harm (n = 16,353 concerns coded to this category), harm to others (n = 11,464 concerns), social/economic impact (n = 6,443 concerns), preventing transmission (n = 4,838 concerns), government/media (n = 1,048 concerns), and general concerns (n = 1,423 concerns). The proportion of respondents reporting any concern declined from 75.3% at baseline to 65.8% at 24-months. Over time, the proportion of respondents reporting concerns about personal harm increased (baseline 41.8% vs. 24-months 52.7%), whereas the proportion reporting concerns about harm to others decreased (baseline 48.5% vs. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight the dynamic and multi-dimensional nature of concerns reported in this cohort during the COVID-19 pandemic. Monitoring specific concerns longitudinally during pandemics could provide valuable insights to inform communication strategies and development of public health interventions.

title_zh: Evolving concerns: A longitudinal content analysis of free-text reports from the UK COVID-19 Public Experiences (COPE) study cohort
source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: Concerns are psychological appraisals of risk that can influence how people respond to threats, including those posed by infectious diseases. The aim of this study was to characterise the evolution of concerns reported by a community cohort during the first two years of the COVID-19 pandemic. DESIGN: Content analysis of qualitative descriptions of concerns in a prospective longitudinal online survey (COVID-19 UK Public Experiences (COPE) Study). METHOD: At baseline (March/April 2020), when the UK entered its first national lockdown, 11,113 adults completed the COPE survey. Follow-up surveys were conducted at 3, 12, 18 and 24 months. Participants were recruited via the HealthWise Wales research registry and social media. Baseline surveys collected demographic and health data. All waves included an open-ended question about COVID-19 concerns. Content analysis was used to identify the frequency of concerns coded to each category and number of individuals reporting concern(s) within each category at each survey wave, as participants could report multiple concerns. RESULTS: Across five survey waves, a total of 22,971 open-text responses were received. The proportion of respondents reporting any concern declined from 75.3% at baseline to 65.8% at 24-months. Monitoring specific concerns longitudinally during pandemics could provide valuable insights to inform communication strategies and development of public health interventions.

title: SARS-CoV-2 Lineage Distribution and Genome Sequence Quality in Zimbabwe, November 2022 to January 2024
abstract: Genomic surveillance of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) depends on sequence quality and reliable specimen linkage. We characterised lineage distribution, genome quality and clinical-data linkage in 731 genomic records from Zimbabwe dated November 2022 to January 2024. Consensus sequences were analyzed using Nextclade, and genomic metadata were linked to clinical records by exact identifiers. Clinical data were available for 697 records; median age was 37 years (interquartile range, 27–48), and 71.4% were female. Fifty-nine Pango lineage assignments and 12 Nextclade clade labels were observed. XBB.1.5 descendants accounted for 443/731 records (60.6%); the most frequent exact assignments were XBB.1.5 (36.4%) and XBB.1.5.28 (17.4%). Quality-control categories were good for 24.9%, mediocre for 42.1% and bad for 33.0%. Identical aligned consensus sequences occurred in 186 pairs involving 372 records (50.9%). Five BA.2.86-group assignments had unresolved date–lineage conflicts. XBB.1.5 descendants were the most frequently assigned group in this historical dataset. Heterogeneous sequence quality, uneven sampling and unresolved record relationships constrain temporal interpretation and preclude national prevalence estimates. The findings highlight the importance of documented specimen linkage and reproducible analysis in retrospective genomic surveillance.

title: Escape at an immunodominant SARS-CoV-2 spike epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in HLA-A ⁎ 24:02 + individuals.
abstract: The antiviral CD8 T cell response is critical for controlling viral infections, including SARS-CoV-2. Spike mutations can mediate escape from pre-existing T cell immunity but it remains unclear whether such variants induce variant-specific CD8 T cells. Here, we investigate the HLA-A⁎24:02-restricted immunodominant NF9/A24 epitope (S448-456) and its prevalent L452R variant (NF9-5R) in Omicron BA.5 convalescents. NF9-5R-specific CD8 T cells are not detected ex vivo or after short-term in vitro stimulation of PBMCs, despite robust responses to other epitopes. In HLA-A24 transgenic mice, NF9 is markedly more immunogenic than NF9-5R, with rare cross-reactive responses. However, in vitro priming of NF9-5R-reactive CD8 T cells enables identification of a cross-reactive TCR (12E) recognizing both peptides and cells expressing spike L452R. Although the NF9-5R peptide can thus be presented and recognized, escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, creating functional "blind spots" relevant to vaccine strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether escape from an immunodominant SARS-CoV-2 spike epitope due to mutations could be compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells, addressing a gap in understanding T cell immunity against viral variants.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on HLA-A⁎24:02 + individuals who had recovered from Omicron BA.5 infections, examining their immune responses to the NF9/A24 epitope and its L452R variant.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed CD8 T cell responses in convalescents using ex vivo and in vitro stimulation of PBMCs, and they used HLA-A24 transgenic mice to assess immunogenicity and cross-reactivity of the epitopes.
analysis.main_results: NF9-5R-specific CD8 T cells were not detected ex vivo or after short-term in vitro stimulation, despite robust responses to other epitopes. In vitro priming identified a cross-reactive TCR (12E) recognizing both the wild-type and variant peptides.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, highlighting a potential functional "blind spot" in immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 variants.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have implications for vaccine strategies, as they indicate that T cell immunity may not effectively counteract immune escape at key epitopes, necessitating further research into broader immune coverage.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and animal models, with in vivo evidence being indirect. The evidence is moderate, as it relies on immunogenicity assessments in transgenic mice and ex vivo human data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates whether CD8 T cell responses to an immunodominant SARS-CoV-2 spike epitope (NF9/A24) and its L452R variant (NF9-5R) in Omicron BA.5 convalescents can compensate for immune escape. The researchers found that NF9-5R-specific CD8 T cells were not detected ex vivo or after short-term in vitro stimulation, despite robust responses to other epitopes. In HLA-A24 transgenic mice, NF9 was more immunogenic than NF9-5R, with rare cross-reactive responses. However, in vitro priming identified a cross-reactive TCR (12E) recognizing both peptides. The authors interpret these findings as indicating that immune escape at an immunodominant epitope is not compensated by variant-specific CD8 T cells in vivo, creating functional "blind spots" relevant to vaccine strategies. The study's evidence is moderate, as it relies on animal models and ex vivo human data, with limitations in directly assessing in vivo immune responses.

analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过体外和体内刺激PBMCs分析康复者的CD8 T细胞反应,并利用HLA-A24转基因小鼠评估表位的免疫原性和交叉反应性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 尽管对其他表位有强反应,但在体外或短期体外刺激后未检测到针对NF9-5R的CD8 T细胞。体外激活识别出一种交叉反应性TCR(12E),其可识别野生型和变异型肽。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在体内免疫优势表位的逃逸无法被特异性CD8 T细胞补偿,突显了免疫应答对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株可能存在的功能"盲点"。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对疫苗策略具有重要意义,因为它们表明T细胞免疫可能无法有效对抗关键表位的免疫逃逸,需要进一步研究更广泛的免疫覆盖。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和动物模型,体内证据是间接的。证据强度中等,因为它依赖于转基因小鼠中的免疫原性评估和体外人类数据。

title: Diverse fullerene amino acids enabled by silyl ester chemistry: a platform for omicron therapeutics.
abstract: A remarkably straightforward, one-step protocol affords water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates from acid chlorides and in situ formed silyl esters. This strategy matches the efficiency of advanced peptide library synthesis. Preliminary screening reveals potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 Omicron inhibitors (selectivity index >143), positioning fullerene derivatives as a variant-resilient antiviral platform.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a versatile platform for creating antiviral therapeutics against SARS-CoV-2 variants, particularly addressing the challenge of variant resistance in existing treatments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research focused on the synthesis of water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates using a one-step protocol, with preliminary screening conducted against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants.
analysis.methods: The study employed silyl ester chemistry to create fullerene-amino acid conjugates, which were then tested for their antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants through preliminary screening.
analysis.main_results: Preliminary screening demonstrated that the synthesized fullerene derivatives exhibited potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 Omicron activity with a selectivity index exceeding 143.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the results as evidence that fullerene derivatives could serve as a variant-resilient antiviral platform, offering a novel approach to combat SARS-CoV-2 Omicron.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that fullerene-based therapeutics may provide a promising strategy for developing treatments that remain effective against emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to preliminary screening, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of comprehensive testing and validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a one-step protocol for synthesizing water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates using silyl ester chemistry. The research focuses on their potential as antiviral agents against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants, with preliminary screening showing potent inhibition (selectivity index >143). The authors interpret these results as indicating that fullerene derivatives could serve as a variant-resilient antiviral platform, offering a novel approach to combat Omicron. The findings suggest a promising strategy for developing treatments effective against emerging variants, though the evidence is limited to initial screening and thus has moderate strength. The study does not provide detailed methods, outcomes, or implications for broader application, but it highlights the potential of fullerene-based therapeutics in antiviral development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一种通用平台,用于创建针对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株的抗病毒药物治疗药物,特别是解决现有治疗治疗药物在变异株耐受性方面的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于通过一步式方法合成水溶性富勒烯-氨基酸和肽偶联物,并对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2奥密克戎变异株进行了初步筛选。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用硅酯化学方法合成富勒烯-氨基酸偶联物,随后通过初步筛选测试其对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2奥密克戎变异株的抗病毒药物活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 初步筛选表明,合成的富勒烯衍生物对奥密克戎变异株表现出强效的抗严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2活性,其选择性指数超过143。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为全氟化碳衍生物可能作为具有抗变异能力的抗病毒药物平台的证据,提供了一种新的方法来应对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2奥密克戎变异株。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于富勒烯的治疗药物可能为开发对新兴严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株仍有效的治疗提供有前景的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于初步筛选,由于缺乏全面的测试和验证,其证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a versatile platform for creating antiviral therapeutics against SARS-CoV-2 variants, particularly addressing the challenge of variant resistance in existing treatments.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The research focused on the synthesis of water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates using a one-step protocol, with preliminary screening conducted against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants.
analysis_en.methods: The study employed silyl ester chemistry to create fullerene-amino acid conjugates, which were then tested for their antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variants through preliminary screening.
analysis_en.main_results: Preliminary screening demonstrated that the synthesized fullerene derivatives exhibited potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 Omicron activity with a selectivity index exceeding 143.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the results as evidence that fullerene derivatives could serve as a variant-resilient antiviral platform, offering a novel approach to combat SARS-CoV-2 Omicron.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that fullerene-based therapeutics may provide a promising strategy for developing treatments that remain effective against emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to preliminary screening, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of comprehensive testing and validation.

title_zh: 通过硅酯化学实现的多样化富勒烯氨基酸:一种针对奥密克戎变异株的治疗平台。
source_body_en: A remarkably straightforward, one-step protocol affords water-soluble fullerene-amino acid and peptide conjugates from acid chlorides and in situ formed silyl esters. This strategy matches the efficiency of advanced peptide library synthesis. Preliminary screening reveals potent anti-SARS-CoV-2 Omicron inhibitors (selectivity index >143), positioning fullerene derivatives as a variant-resilient antiviral platform.
abstract_zh: 一种令人惊叹的简单、一步式方法可从酸氯化物和原位形成的硅酯直接制备水溶性富勒烯-氨基酸和肽偶联物。该策略与先进的肽文库合成方法的效率相当。初步筛选显示,合成的富勒烯衍生物对奥密克戎变异株表现出强效的抗严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2活性(选择性指数>143),表明富勒烯衍生物可作为具有变异株耐受性的抗病毒药物治疗平台。

title: Changes in age-specific patterns of household transmission of SARS-CoV-2 over six epidemic waves in 2020–2022: a population-based study in Japan
abstract: BACKGROUND: Household transmission is a major driver of SARS-CoV-2 spread; however, longitudinal data comparing household transmission patterns across variant-specific waves remain limited. We aimed to compare household secondary attack rates (SARs) across epidemic waves and identify factors associated with household transmission. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used the JMDC Claims Database, a nationwide health insurance claims database in Japan. Six epidemic waves from January 2020 to May 2022 were defined based on temporal trends in reported COVID-19 cases and grouped into four analytical periods according to predominant variants. Index cases were defined as the first diagnosed household member per period. Household SAR was the proportion of household contacts diagnosed within 1-10 days of the index case. Period differences were estimated using linear regression models. Factors associated with household transmission were examined using multivariable mixed-effects logistic regression models. RESULTS: Analyzing 124,136 index cases and 287,886 contacts, household SAR during the Omicron period among pediatric index cases increased compared with the pre-Alpha period, with adjusted increases of 27.6 and 21.3 percentage points in children aged 0-4 and 5-11 years, respectively. In the pre-Alpha and Alpha periods, child index cases had lower odds of secondary transmission than index cases aged 19-64 years, whereas odds were higher in the Omicron period. Age-specific susceptibility among contacts also varied across analytical periods. CONCLUSIONS: Household transmission patterns changed across waves, marked by increased SARs among pediatric index cases during the Omicron period. These findings inform age-adapted public health strategies for future respiratory-viral pandemics.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来呼吸道病毒大流行中的年龄适应性公共卫生策略提供了依据,强调了理解特定变异株传播模式的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖保险索赔数据,可能无法涵盖所有病例,且可能存在未测量的混杂因素。由于研究的观察性质,其证据强度为中等。

title: Pericarditis in COVID-19: a focus on the paediatric population
abstract: BACKGROUND: COVID-19, caused by SARS-CoV-2, is primarily a respiratory illness but may cause cardiovascular complications, including pericarditis. Pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis remains uncommon and likely underreported. This review summarizes the epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, management, and outcomes of pericarditis associated with SARS-CoV-2 infection in children. METHODS: We narratively reviewed the available literature on SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis in the pediatric population, including isolated acute pericarditis, myopericarditis, pericardial effusion, cardiac tamponade, and pericardial involvement in multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). RESULTS: The true incidence of pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis remains unclear. Reported cases suggest that older children and adolescents are more commonly affected, typically presenting with chest pain, fever, dyspnea, or tachycardia, whereas younger children may exhibit nonspecific symptoms. Diagnosis relies on clinical criteria supported by electrocardiography, echocardiography, inflammatory markers, and cardiac biomarkers, with cardiac magnetic resonance imaging useful when myocardial involvement is suspected. Available evidence suggests a predominantly immune-mediated pathophysiology involving cytokine dysregulation and systemic inflammation, with limited evidence of direct viral invasion. Management is largely extrapolated from established pediatric pericarditis principles and adult data. Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and colchicine are first-line therapies, while corticosteroids or intravenous immunoglobulin may be considered in selected inflammatory or MIS-C-associated cases, and interleukin-1 blockade in refractory or recurrent disease. Most affected children recover, although severe pericardial effusion, tamponade, and recurrence have been reported. CONCLUSION: Pediatric SARS-CoV-2-associated pericarditis encompasses a spectrum of clinical presentations and generally carries a favorable prognosis. Nevertheless, potentially serious complications emphasize the importance of early recognition, differentiation from myocarditis and MIS-C, and structured follow-up.

These findings suggest a need for further research and improved diagnostic protocols in this population.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关的心包炎在儿科人群中的情况,探讨其流行病学、发病机制、临床表现、诊断、管理及预后。核心问题是严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2感染是否会导致儿童心包炎,以及其与其他心血管并发症的比较。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关心包炎现有文献的叙述性综合分析,包括孤立性急性心包炎、心肌心包炎、心包积液、心包填塞以及儿童多系统炎症综合征(MIS-C)中的心包受累情况。方法部分未明确说明系统性搜索或荟萃分析,但指出综述方法为叙述性综述。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关的心包炎具有多种临床表现形式,总体预后良好。大多数受影响的儿童能够恢复,但也有报道指出严重的心包积液、填塞和复发情况。其发病机制主要为免疫介导,涉及细胞因子失调和全身性炎症,直接病毒侵袭的证据有限。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关心包炎的确切发病率仍不清楚。此外,关于疾病的确切发病机制尚无共识,直接病毒侵袭的证据有限。另外,儿童病例的管理主要基于成人数据和已建立的儿科心包炎原则,可能未完全适用于此特定情况。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步研究以明确儿童严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2相关心包炎的确切发病率,并更好地理解其发病机制。需要更多针对性的研究来探讨免疫机制和潜在的病毒相互作用。此外,呼吁进行结构化随访,并改善与心肌炎和MIS-C的鉴别诊断,以确保准确的诊断和适当的管理。

title: Spiritual Health Locus of Control and COVID-19 Booster Intentions Among Hispanic Americans: A Culturally Grounded Extension of the Extended Parallel Process Model.
abstract: Declining uptake of COVID-19 boosters poses significant public health concerns. Hispanic Americans, who have experienced disproportionate pandemic impacts, report lower uptake of updated boosters than non-Hispanic White adults, partly attributable to vaccine hesitancy. Although religiosity plays a central role in Hispanic communities, little is known about how spiritually grounded beliefs shape cognitive and emotional responses to vaccination. This study integrates the extended parallel process model (EPPM) with spiritual health locus of control (SHLOC) to examine how exposure to faith-based and governmental vaccine information influences booster intention through spiritually grounded efficacy appraisals. Using an online survey of Hispanic American adults ( N = 349), we tested a structural equation model linking SHLOC, perceived threat, efficacy beliefs, fear, and vaccination intentions. Results indicated that active SHLOC, reflecting beliefs in divine partnership in health, increased response efficacy and indirectly promoted booster intention and vaccine advocacy, whereas passive SHLOC, reflecting divine determinism, reduced self-efficacy and indirectly discouraged booster intention. Perceived threat was positively associated with fear, and efficacy beliefs emerged as the strongest predictors of booster intention. Mediation analyses supported serial pathways from message exposure to SHLOC to efficacy to intention, identifying spiritually grounded control beliefs as a culturally embedded mechanism in vaccine decision making. Findings suggest that faith-based engagement can function as either a protective or risk communication channel, depending on whether messages reinforce divine partnership or determinism. The study advances EPPM by identifying SHLOC as a culturally grounded antecedent to efficacy appraisal and offers implications for culturally responsive vaccine communication in Hispanic communities.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: The study examines how spiritual health locus of control (SHLOC) influences booster intentions among Hispanic Americans during the COVID-19 pandemic, with a focus on the role of faith-based and governmental vaccine information in shaping cognitive and emotional responses to vaccination.
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本研究基于对349名西班牙裔美国成年人的在线调查。采用结构方程模型将SHLOC、感知威胁、效能信念、恐惧和疫苗接种意图联系起来。研究未报告具体数据库、检索日期或纳入标准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 主动型SHLOC反映了对健康中神圣合作的信念,与反应效能增加相关,并间接促进了加强针意图和疫苗倡导行为。被动型SHLOC反映了神圣决定论,降低了自我效能,并间接抑制了加强针意图。感知威胁与恐惧呈正相关,效能信念是加强针意图最强的预测因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本研究未直接报告争议或证据缺口。然而,它承认目前对精神层面的信念如何影响对疫苗接种的认知和情感反应了解甚少,突显了在理解SHLOC在疫苗决策中的作用方面存在潜在的证据缺口。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,基于信仰的参与可以作为保护性或风险性沟通渠道,这取决于信息是否强化神圣合作或决定论。本研究为西班牙裔社区中文化敏感的疫苗沟通提供了启示。

title: COVID-19 risk perceptions after the end of the public health emergency
abstract: We examine how information provision affects the public's perceived COVID-19 infection risk after the official end of the pandemic as a public health emergency (PHE). We conducted our survey in Japan in August 2023, a few months after the government reclassified COVID-19 from Category II to Category V and officially ended the PHE. We find that none of the information treatments affected the public's risk perceptions in a statistically significant way, in stark contrast with a similar information-provision experiment conducted right before the reclassification. Our results are consistent with reduced public responsiveness to news about infection following the official end of the PHE.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines how information provision affects the public's perceived risk of COVID-19 infection after the official end of the public health emergency (PHE).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study was conducted in Japan in August 2023, a few months after the government reclassified COVID-19 from Category II to Category V and officially ended the PHE. The review uses a survey-based approach to assess public risk perceptions.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The findings indicate that none of the information treatments had a statistically significant effect on the public's risk perceptions of COVID-19, contrasting with a similar experiment conducted before the reclassification.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The results suggest reduced public responsiveness to news about infection following the official end of the PHE, but the evidence does not provide detailed mechanisms or broader population insights.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for further research on public risk perceptions post-PHE and the potential impact of information provision in shaping these perceptions.

analysis.summary_en: This review investigates how information provision influences public risk perceptions of COVID-19 after the official end of the public health emergency (PHE) in Japan. Conducted in August 2023, the study contrasts with a similar experiment before the PHE's reclassification. The results show no statistically significant effect of information treatments on risk perceptions, suggesting reduced public responsiveness to infection news post-PHE. The findings emphasize the importance of understanding public behavior and the role of information in shaping perceptions, with implications for future research and public health strategies.

title: German medical students’ learning environment during the fading COVID-19 pandemic
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Medical School's learning environment (MSLE) is important for medical students' academic performance and mental well-being. COVID-19 disrupted medical education worldwide through restrictions on practical and in-person teaching. Although several studies have showcased the immediate effects on medical students' perceptions of MSLE and mental well-being, less is known about the changes during the transition to post-pandemic medical education. METHODS: Four cross-sectional online surveys were conducted at a German medical school between winter 2021/2022 and summer 2023. MSLE was assessed using three items from the Johns Hopkins Learning Environment Scale (JHLES) and three self-developed items. Various validated items assessed distress (DT), perceived stress (PSS-4), depression (PHQ-2), anxiety (GAD-2), and loneliness (R-UCLA-3). Analyses included group comparisons and binary logistic regression. RESULTS: Across four survey waves, 687 individual medical and dental students participated. Positive MSLE perceptions were more frequent in later waves, although differences were not significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Social connectedness and access to mentoring were reported significantly more frequently in later waves. Higher age, more advanced study years, greater perceived stress, and perceived lack of practical experience were associated with lower odds of positive MSLE. The proportion reporting decreased study motivation since the onset of COVID-19 was significantly lower in the final wave. Older students, those in more advanced study years, and those experiencing loneliness or distress more frequently reported decreased motivation. Mental burden showed varying patterns: loneliness was generally lower in later waves, distress peaked in summer 2022, depressive symptoms and perceived stress in winter 2022/2023, and anxiety in summer 2023. After correction for multiple comparisons, only differences in distress across survey waves remained significant. Female students reported higher anxiety, loneliness, and perceived stress than male students, but only the gender difference in anxiety remained significant after correction. CONCLUSION: Medical students reported a more positive perception of the MSLE in later survey waves during the transition from pandemic to post-pandemic medical education. However, these improvements were not matched by a uniform recovery in medical students' well-being. Medical schools are therefore encouraged to strengthen students' learning environments by ensuring learning opportunities, mentoring, and mental health support throughout training.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates the impact of the fading COVID-19 pandemic on the learning environment of German medical students, focusing on their perceptions of the Medical School's Learning Environment (MSLE) and mental well-being. The central question is whether the transition to post-pandemic education has led to improvements in MSLE and student well-being.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on four cross-sectional online surveys conducted at a German medical school between winter 2021/2022 and summer 2023. The MSLE was assessed using three items from the Johns Hopkins Learning Environment Scale (JHLES) and three self-developed items. Mental health was evaluated using validated scales for distress (DT), perceived stress (PSS-4), depression (PHQ-2), anxiety (GAD-2), and loneliness (R-UCLA-3). Analyses included group comparisons and binary logistic regression.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Medical students reported a more positive perception of the MSLE in later survey waves during the transition from pandemic to post-pandemic medical education. However, these improvements were not matched by a uniform recovery in medical students' well-being. Higher age, more advanced study years, greater perceived stress, and perceived lack of practical experience were associated with lower odds of positive MSLE.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study found that while positive MSLE perceptions increased over time, the changes were not statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. The proportion of students reporting decreased study motivation was significantly lower in the final wave, but this was not consistent across all demographic groups. The evidence also highlights varying patterns in mental health indicators, with distress peaking in summer 2022 and anxiety in summer 2023, suggesting unresolved issues in student well-being.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Medical schools are encouraged to strengthen students' learning environments by ensuring learning opportunities, mentoring, and mental health support throughout training. The study suggests a need for targeted interventions to address the mental health challenges faced by students, particularly those in more advanced study years and those experiencing loneliness or distress.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the impact of the fading COVID-19 pandemic on the learning environment and mental well-being of German medical students. Four cross-sectional surveys were conducted between winter 2021/2022 and summer 2023, assessing the Medical School's Learning Environment (MSLE) using standardized and self-developed items. The findings indicate that while perceptions of MSLE improved in later survey waves, there was no uniform recovery in student well-being. Factors such as age, study year, perceived stress, and lack of practical experience were linked to lower odds of positive MSLE. The study highlights the need for continued support in learning environments and mental health resources for medical students, especially those facing higher stress or loneliness.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述基于2021/2022年冬季至2023年夏季期间在德国一所医学院进行的四次横断面在线调查。MSLE的评估采用约翰霍普金斯学习环境量表(JHLES)的三个项目以及三个自编项目。心理健康状况使用经过验证的量表进行评估,包括压力(DT)、感知压力(PSS-4)、抑郁(PHQ-2)、焦虑(GAD-2)和孤独(R-UCLA-3)。分析包括组间比较和二元逻辑回归。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在疫情向后疫情时代医学教育过渡期间,医学生在后期调查中对MSLE的感知更加积极。然而,这些改善并未与医学生整体心理健康状况的统一恢复相匹配。较高的年龄、更高级的学习阶段、较高的感知压力以及感知到缺乏实践经验与积极的MSLE感知概率较低相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 研究发现,尽管对MSLE的积极感知随时间有所增加,但经过多重比较校正后,这些变化并不具有统计学意义。学习动机下降的比例在最后一次调查中显著降低,但这一趋势并非所有人口统计学群体都一致。证据还表明心理健康指标呈现出不同的模式,压力在2022年夏季达到峰值,焦虑则在2023年夏季上升,这表明学生心理健康状况仍存在未解决的问题。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 鼓励医学院在整个培训过程中加强学生的学习环境,确保学习机会、指导和心理健康支持。该研究还建议需要有针对性的干预措施,以解决学生面临的心理健康挑战,特别是那些学习阶段更高级以及经常经历孤独或压力的学生。

title: Efficacy of Nirmatrelvir/Ritonavir in High-Risk Adults with Preexisting SARS-CoV-2 Immunity: A Pooled Analysis of Two Randomized Controlled Trials
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir (NMV/r) is an oral antiviral treatment approved to treat mild-to-moderate COVID-19 among adults at high risk of severe disease. We conducted a pooled analysis of NMV/r efficacy among high-risk participants from two clinical trials who had evidence of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) immunity through vaccination or previous infection. METHODS: Data were pooled from a subset of participants from the Evaluation of Protease Inhibition for COVID-19 in High-Risk Patients (EPIC-HR) trial (high-risk, unvaccinated) who were baseline seropositive for SARS-CoV-2 antibodies and high-risk Evaluation of Protease Inhibition for COVID-19 in Standard-Risk Patients (EPIC-SR) participants who were vaccinated against SARS-CoV-2. In both trials, participants were randomized within 5 days of symptom onset to twice-daily NMV/r 300/100 mg or placebo for 5 days. Endpoints included coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)-related hospitalization or all-cause death through day 28, number of medical visits, time to symptom alleviation, and percentage of participants with severe symptoms. RESULTS: Overall, 1600 participants were included in the pooled analysis (NMV/r, 807 [EPIC-HR, n = 490; EPIC-SR, n = 317]; placebo, 793 [EPIC-HR, n = 479; EPIC-SR, n = 314]). NMV/r significantly reduced COVID-19-related hospitalization or all-cause death by 73.7% compared with placebo (0.5% versus 1.9%, P = 0.0104). Relative to placebo, NMV/r was also associated with fewer medical visits (21 versus 53, P = 0.0076) and a 2-day reduction in time to symptom alleviation (12 versus 14 days, P = 0.0470). Participants treated with NMV/r were less likely to report severe targeted COVID-19 symptoms compared with placebo (22.1% relative reduction on days 2-6 [P = 0.0441]; 46.6% relative reduction on days 7-28 [P = 0.0011]). CONCLUSIONS: NMV/r reduced hospitalization and death, medical visits, time to symptom alleviation, and severe symptoms among high-risk participants with preexisting SARS-CoV-2 immunity. CLINICAL TRIALS REGISTRATION: NCT04960202; NCT05011513.

source_records.abstract: INTRODUCTION Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir (NMV/r) is an oral antiviral treatment approved to treat mild-to-moderate COVID-19 among adults at high risk of severe disease. We conducted a pooled analysis of NMV/r efficacy among high-risk participants from two clinical trials who had evidence of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) immunity through vaccination or previous infection. METHODS Data were pooled from a subset of participants from the Evaluation of Protease Inhibition for COVID-19 in High-Risk Patients (EPIC-HR) trial (high-risk, unvaccinated) who were baseline seropositive for SARS-CoV-2 antibodies and high-risk Evaluation of Protease Inhibition for COVID-19 in Standard-Risk Patients (EPIC-SR) participants who were vaccinated against SARS-CoV-2. In both trials, participants were randomized within 5 days of symptom onset to twice-daily NMV/r 300/100 mg or placebo for 5 days. Endpoints included coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)-related hospitalization or all-cause death through day 28, number of medical visits, time to symptom alleviation, and percentage of participants with severe symptoms. RESULTS Overall, 1600 participants were included in the pooled analysis (NMV/r, 807 [EPIC-HR, n = 490; EPIC-SR, n = 317]; placebo, 793 [EPIC-HR, n = 479; EPIC-SR, n = 314]). Relative to placebo, NMV/r was also associated with fewer medical visits (21 versus 53, P = 0.0076) and a 2-day reduction in time to symptom alleviation (12 versus 14 days, P = 0.0470). Participants treated with NMV/r were less likely to report severe targeted COVID-19 symptoms compared with placebo (22.1% relative reduction on days 2-6 [P = 0.0441]; 46.6% relative reduction on days 7-28 [P = 0.0011]). CONCLUSIONS NMV/r reduced hospitalization and death, medical visits, time to symptom alleviation, and severe symptoms among high-risk participants with preexisting SARS-CoV-2 immunity. CLINICAL TRIALS REGISTRATION NCT04960202; NCT05011513.

title: Identificação in silico de mutações das variantes de preocupação do SARS-CoV-2 em sítios de anelamento e redesenho dos primers e sondas de RT-qPCR afetados In silico identification of SARS-CoV-2 variant-of-concern mutations in annealing sites and redesign of the affected RT-qPCR primers and probes
abstract: COVID-19, caused by SARS-CoV-2, exhibits high genetic variability, and mutations in regions recognized by primers and probes may compromise the reliability of RT-qPCR tests. This study assessed the impact of variant-of-concern mutations on the annealing sites of diagnostic assays and proposed corrected sets for the affected assays. This is a descriptive-analytical in silico study. Six complete genomes, the Wuhan-Hu-1 reference and one representative of each variant of concern (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and Omicron), were retrieved from GenBank and aligned with Clustal Omega. Forty oligonucleotides from five protocols (CDC, Charité/WHO, China CDC, HKU and Institut Pasteur) were mapped onto the reference genome. After consolidating sequences identical across protocols, 37 unique oligonucleotides organised into 12 sets were analysed. Thirty remained intact across the five variants and seven displayed at least one mismatch, totalling 18 events, all non-synonymous, distributed over 11 genomic positions. The China CDC N set concentrated 12 of these events by overlapping the 28,881–28,883 cluster, the origin of the R203K and G204R substitutions. One event was classified as highly critical: the substitution at position 15,451 (ORF1b:G662S, Delta variant), located one base from the 3′ end of the forward primer of the RdRP_SARSr set. New sets were designed for the five affected assays, restricted to the 28,825 positions (96.4% of the genome) conserved across all six sequences, showing complete complementarity and adequate thermodynamic parameters. Specificity screening against the six reference human coronaviruses indicated no expected reactivity with MERS-CoV or with the seasonal coronaviruses, although the sets targeting ORF1b and the E gene retain recognition of SARS-CoV, a property inherited from the original pan-Sarbecovirus design. Global genome conservation does not ensure the integrity of diagnostic sites, and monitoring these regions should be integrated into routine genomic surveillance.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the concern that mutations in SARS-CoV-2 variants may affect the reliability of RT-qPCR diagnostic tests by compromising the annealing sites of primers and probes.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study was a descriptive-analytical in silico investigation assessing the impact of variant-of-concern mutations on diagnostic assays, using six complete genomes including the Wuhan-Hu-1 reference and representatives of Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, and Omicron variants.
elements_en.methods: The study retrieved six complete genomes from GenBank and aligned them with Clustal Omega. It mapped forty oligonucleotides from five protocols onto the reference genome and consolidated sequences identical across protocols to identify unique oligonucleotides.
elements_en.main_results: Thirty oligonucleotides remained intact across the five variants, while seven displayed at least one mismatch, resulting in 18 non-synonymous events distributed over 11 genomic positions. One event at position 15,451 (ORF1b:G662S, Delta variant) was classified as highly critical.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that global genome conservation does not guarantee the integrity of diagnostic sites, highlighting the need for monitoring these regions. They proposed new primer and probe sets that maintain complete complementarity and adequate thermodynamic parameters.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of integrating genomic surveillance of diagnostic sites into routine practices to ensure the accuracy of RT-qPCR tests for SARS-CoV-2 variants.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in silico analysis, which may not fully capture real-world performance. However, the evidence is strong as it is based on alignment of six complete genomes and specificity screening against six reference human coronaviruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决关注变异株突变在严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株中可能影响RT-qPCR诊断检测可靠性的担忧,因为这些突变可能破坏引物和探针的环化位点。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项描述性分析的In silico调查,评估关注变异株突变对诊断试验的影响,使用了六条完整的基因组序列,包括武汉-Hu-1参考序列和Alpha、Beta、Gamma、Delta及Omicron变异株的代表性序列。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究从GenBank中检索了六条完整的基因组序列,并使用Clustal Omega将其与参考序列进行比对。然后将五个协议中的40条寡核苷酸序列映射到参考基因组序列上,并整合各协议中相同的序列以识别独特的寡核苷酸序列。
elements_zh.main_results: 30条寡核苷酸在五个变异株中保持完整,而7条显示至少一个不匹配,总计18个非同义事件,分布在11个基因组位置。其中位于位置15,451(ORF1b:G662S,Delta变异株)的事件被归类为高度关键。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,全球基因组序列的保守性并不能确保诊断位点的完整性,强调了对这些区域进行监测的必要性。他们提出了新的引物和探针集合,这些集合保持了完全互补性和适当的热力学参数。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了将基因组监测纳入常规诊断位点监测实践的重要性,以确保对严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2变异株的RT-qPCR检测准确性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于In silico分析,可能无法完全反映实际性能。然而,证据较强,因为它基于六条完整基因组序列的比对以及对六种参考人类冠状病毒的特异性筛选。

title_zh: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2关注变异株在环化位点的In silico突变鉴定及受影响的RT-qPCR引物和探针重新设计
source_body_en: COVID-19, caused by SARS-CoV-2, exhibits high genetic variability, and mutations in regions recognized by primers and probes may compromise the reliability of RT-qPCR tests. This study assessed the impact of variant-of-concern mutations on the annealing sites of diagnostic assays and proposed corrected sets for the affected assays. This is a descriptive-analytical in silico study. Six complete genomes, the Wuhan-Hu-1 reference and one representative of each variant of concern (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and Omicron), were retrieved from GenBank and aligned with Clustal Omega. Forty oligonucleotides from five protocols (CDC, Charité/WHO, China CDC, HKU and Institut Pasteur) were mapped onto the reference genome. After consolidating sequences identical across protocols, 37 unique oligonucleotides organised into 12 sets were analysed. Thirty remained intact across the five variants and seven displayed at least one mismatch, totalling 18 events, all non-synonymous, distributed over 11 genomic positions. The China CDC N set concentrated 12 of these events by overlapping the 28,881–28,883 cluster, the origin of the R203K and G204R substitutions. One event was classified as highly critical: the substitution at position 15,451 (ORF1b:G662S, Delta variant), located one base from the 3′ end of the forward primer of the RdRP_SARSr set. New sets were designed for the five affected assays, restricted to the 28,825 positions (96.4% of the genome) conserved across all six sequences, showing complete complementarity and adequate thermodynamic parameters. Specificity screening against the six reference human coronaviruses indicated no expected reactivity with MERS-CoV or with the seasonal coronaviruses, although the sets targeting ORF1b and the E gene retain recognition of SARS-CoV, a property inherited from the original pan-Sarbecovirus design. Global genome conservation does not ensure the integrity of diagnostic sites, and monitoring these regions should be integrated into routine genomic surveillance.

title: Personalized HLA-aware TCR measure predicts the risk of symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection following booster vaccination
abstract: HLA-driven heterogeneity and limitations of live T cell functional assays routinely thwart assessment of cell-mediated immunity in vaccination trials. To address this, we developed a T-cell receptor (TCR)-based measure of immunogen recognition and evaluated it in COV-BOOST, a third-dose COVID-19 vaccine trial, during the Delta and Omicron waves (2021-2022, United Kingdom). We estimated HLA-aware Spike-reactive T cell (HA-TS) breadth from participant HLA genotypes, TCR{beta} repertoires, and a novel SARS-CoV-2 S HLA-linked reference catalog. Higher post-boost HA-TS breadth was associated with lower symptomatic infection risk (HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.39-0.86). This association persisted after adjustment for neutralizing antibody titers and IFN-{gamma} responses. Examination of HA-TS across prior studies showed that it reflects participant genotype, exposure intensity, and time from exposure to sampling. These findings highlight the possibility that estimates of antigen-specific T cell repertoire breadth could serve as a correlate of protection to accelerate vaccine development.
